title: Legendary Trainer
overview: Gold stands atop the temporal summit of Mt. Silver as the supreme test of your journey. His roster features fearsome Johto beast fusions: lead Sudowoodo/Shuckle leverages Sturdy and Rocky Helmet with Power Split to punish physical attackers; Togekiss/Umbreon provides durable Fairy/Dark recovery; the legendary beast fusions (Feraligatr/Raikou, Typhlosion/Suicune, Meganium/Entei) command dynamic weather offense; and his ace Dragonite/Gyarados combines Intimidate, lustrous Water/Dragon power, and priority Extreme Speed. Avoid physical contact against Shuckle, disrupt their weather setups, and target their glaring quad-weaknesses (Ice for Dragonite/Gyarados, Ground for Raikou/Entei).

roster.tactics: Extreme 191 Defense tank. Sturdy guarantees survival from any single hit, and Counter/Rocky Helmet severely punishes physical contact. Neutralize it with special Water or Steel attacks.
Sturdy Fairy/Dark wall with 120 Sp. Def and Moonlight recovery. Break through with strong physical Poison or Steel attacks like Sludge Bomb or Iron Head.
Fast 102 Speed rain sweeper. Sets Rain Dance to boost Thunder and Water Pulse. Exploit its low 83 Defense with a fast, fatal Earthquake.
Bulky mixed elemental attacker with 102 Sp. Atk and 102 Defense. Hit its Electric, Ground, or Rock weaknesses before it sets up offensive momentum.
Sets Sunny Day to fire instant Solar Beams and boosted Fire Blasts while recovering with boosted Synthesis. Punish with Flying, Poison, or Rock moves.
Gold's devastating 128 Attack ace with Intimidate and STAB Extreme Speed. Annihilate it immediately with a 4x Ice Beam or Blizzard.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Lead with Alakazam/Weezing to easily dispatch Sudowoodo/Shuckle using special Psychic. Pivot Lapras in against Dragonite/Gyarados to instantly erase it with 4x Ice Beam. Venusaur/Charizard walls Meganium/Entei and tears through Togekiss/Umbreon with Sludge Bomb, while Gyarados/Arbok absorbs physical hits and cleans up with Earthquake.
starter_strategies.charmander: Lead with Nidoking/Machamp to crush Sudowoodo/Shuckle and Feraligatr/Raikou with STAB Earthquake. Jolteon/Tentacruel outspeeds and vaporizes Typhlosion/Suicune and Dragonite/Gyarados with Thunderbolt and Ice Beam. Charizard/Pinsir and Raichu/Gengar clean up remaining threats with blistering speed.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Deploy Blastoise/Tangrowth with Regenerator to completely shut down Dragonite/Gyarados and Shuckle physically. Magnezone/Electabuzz obliterates Typhlosion/Suicune and Feraligatr/Raikou with 100% accurate Thunder, while Tyranitar/Arcanine melts Meganium/Entei and Togekiss/Umbreon.

rewards: Shiny Charm (Awarded by Mom in Pallet Town)
Access to Tier 3 Elite Four Rematches (Lv. 81-90)
Unlocking of Legendary Triple Fusions via Super DNA Splicers
